school_name: Pathways Learning Academy at Northview Church - Binford
welcome_text: Welcome to Our School Welcome to Pathways Learning Academy at Northview Church – Binford! Our daycare and preschool in Indianapolis, IN, is located on Northview Way and offers a caring learning environment for children from 6 weeks to 5 years old. Our programs include Infants, Toddlers, Twos, Early Preschool, Preschool, Pre-K, Junior Kindergarten, and Summer Camp. Children are encouraged to learn by doing, with classroom experiences that support curiosity, creativity, problem-solving, and social development. As children grow, our teachers introduce new challenges and experiences that help them become more confident and independent. From establishing early routines and relationships to developing skills for kindergarten, we focus on helping each child make meaningful progress. We also make it easy for families to be part of their child's day with SproutAbout®, our family communication app featuring live streaming classroom video and real-time updates. Located in Indianapolis on Northview Way, our school is proud to support families in the surrounding community. Schedule a tour to meet our team and discover what your child's day could look like at Pathways Learning Academy!

Daycare and Early Education Programs Infants In this nurturing, stimulating environment, a strong foundation is built for future learning. Toddlers Active and mobile learners channel their energy into exploring throughout the classroom. Twos Two-year-olds are on the move! This classroom offers them engaging, interactive experiences. Early Preschool Get a jump on Preschool! This program is designed specifically for 30- to 42-month-old learners. Preschool Learn and grow! This is an essential stepping stone to kindergarten, featuring hands-on learning. Junior Kindergarten This bridge to kindergarten gives children the independence and confidence to succeed in school. Summer Camp Open your mind to one amazing summer. Open a window to your child's day. SproutAbout ® , our exclusive family app, provides free live streaming video of your child's classroom to your mobile device. Proud to be Accredited! We've been recognized as a high-quality early education program. Faith Experiences Pathways Learning Academy offers high-quality care and education to start your child on the right path to be best prepared for kindergarten and beyond. Our host church will have a dedicated member of their ministry join our school community on a weekly basis to offer Christian-based activities, events, and lessons for enrolled children. Diversity + Inclusion At our school, all are welcome and appreciated. We encourage everyone to share their voice, listen to others, and help us strengthen our community.
